tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every view; the header sits on it too. Same value as Core `paper`.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised ground: cards, inputs, outline buttons, list items, the Kage frame. Same value as Core `surface`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, select lists, tooltips and toasts; always paired with `shadow-pop`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Recessed ground: code blocks, the Kage frame bar, skeletons, tab counts, hovered table rows. Same value as Core `sunken`.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Fill of secondary buttons and neutral badges.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover fill for ghost and outline buttons, menu items and unselected list items. Not the identity colour: that is `primary`.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Ground of the left navigation.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `background`, `card`, `muted` and `sidebar`. Same value as Core `ink`.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover`.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary`.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `sidebar`.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, overlines, placeholders and resting icons on `background`, `card`, `muted`, `sidebar` and `primary-soft` (4.5:1 or better on each). Same value as Core `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card edges, dividers, table rules, pane splits. Never the edge of a control. Same value as Core `line`.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Edge of every interactive control: inputs, selects, outline buttons, outline and draft badges (3:1 or better on `card`, `background` and `sidebar`). Same value as Core `line-control`.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: The rule between the sidebar and the page.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The identity colour, brass. The one primary button in a view, the active tab underline, the selected list item's edge, the monogram tile. Readable as text or icon on `background`, `card`, `sidebar` and `primary-soft`. Same value as Core `accent`.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `primary` fill. Dark in the dark theme, never literal white.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tint of the selected thing: selected Kage in a list, selected block in the tree. `foreground` text sits on it. Same value as Core `accent-soft`.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Monogram tile and the active nav item's icon.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-primary`.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Hovered and active nav item fill.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-accent`.

tokens.name: wire
tokens.usage: The colour of connection, teal. Links, `$block` and `$state` references, bound props, wired blocks in the tree, the Review state. Readable as text on `background`, `card`, `muted`, `sidebar`, `wire-soft` and `primary-soft`. Same value as Core `wire`.

tokens.name: wire-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a bound prop and the Review badge; `wire` or `foreground` text sits on it.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring on every interactive control: a solid 1px `ring` edge plus a 3px halo of `ring` at 50%.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside the sidebar.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Valid, published, positive. Text and icons on `background`, `card` and `success-soft`. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the Published badge.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings and the Deprecated state. Text and icons on `background`, `card` and `warning-soft`. Same value as Ledger `ledger-wire`.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the Deprecated badge and warning banners.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors, failed validation, destructive actions. Text and icons on `background`, `card` and `destructive-soft`. Same value as Core `danger`.

tokens.name: destructive-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of the destructive button and error banners.

tokens.name: sys-core
tokens.usage: Monogram tile for a Kage in Core. The system's own `accent`; never use it for anything but identifying Core.

tokens.name: sys-core-foreground
tokens.usage: Letters on `sys-core`.

tokens.name: sys-ledger
tokens.usage: Monogram tile for a Kage in Ledger. The system's own `ledger-accent`.

tokens.name: sys-ledger-foreground
tokens.usage: Letters on `sys-ledger`.

tokens.name: sys-atelier
tokens.usage: Monogram tile for a Kage in Atelier. The system's own `atelier-accent`.

tokens.name: sys-atelier-foreground
tokens.usage: Letters on `sys-atelier`.

tokens.usage: First data series.

tokens.name: chart-2

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third data series.

tokens.name: chart-4

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per view: the page or selected Kage title.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default text, inputs, table cells, nav items.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, list item titles, the active nav item.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Small buttons, toast body, dense secondary text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, stat labels, badges, list meta.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase in CSS: nav group labels, table heads, pane heads.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Anything a machine addresses: system ids, block ids, describe output, JSON.

styles.name: ref
styles.usage: Kage refs, digests and principals under a title.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label in a badge; field label to control.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label in a button or nav item; gaps in toolbars; sidebar padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List item padding; table cell padding; gaps between list items and rows of meta.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; grid gap between cards; header side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page padding; gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty state padding.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Badges, system tiles, tree rows, tab counts.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Controls: buttons, inputs, selects, nav items, menus and their items, skeletons.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Containers: cards, list items, code blocks, the Kage frame, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: The only shadow: menus, select lists, tooltips, toasts. Cards and panes never cast one.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Left navigation, expanded.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Sticky page header.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a centred page (Dashboard, Viewer).

tokens.name: master-width
tokens.usage: List column of the Artifacts workbench.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, nav items.

tokens.name: control-height-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, tree rows.
